mechanism.claim: In turbulent Bitcoin regimes, the sign of a fixed exponentially weighted conditional skew estimate represents the direction of time-varying expected return compensation. Follow the sign of thirty completed daily returns' EWMA skew for twenty-four hours when both skew magnitude and twenty-day variation are causally high.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed thirty-day EWMA conditional skew estimate
mechanism.why_distinct: HVRSR fades one day's intraday normalized third moment; directional-tail candidates compare positive and negative minute tails. HVEWCS uses thirty separate completed daily close-to-close returns, a fixed seven-day half-life central-moment estimator, and follows rather than fades conditional skew only in a high daily-variation state, with no prior event, fitted return, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed twenty-day daily realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one 02:05 UTC daily conditional-skew clock with twenty-four-hour reservation is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every calendar day at exact 02:00 UTC
features.daily_returns: thirty completed UTC-02:00 close-to-close BTC log returns ending at decision, requiring thirty-one exact coherent daily endpoint closes
features.weights: fixed exponentially decaying weights with seven-day half-life, newest return highest, normalized to sum one
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared final twenty daily returns), finite strict positive
features.prior_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 180 earlier source-valid daily decisions, minimum 120, current excluded

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: paper-supported positive conditional-skew relation in turbulent regimes with fixed EWMA estimator

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no return window, half-life, moment estimator, rank history, skew strength, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.paper: Time-varying expected returns, conditional skewness and Bitcoin return predictability
external_basis.reported_relation: conditional skewness predicts future Bitcoin returns; relation is positive in the turmoil subsample
external_basis.selection_use: mechanism sign in volatile regimes only; no repository incidence or outcome opened
